name: x_add_wrong_reg
subs: f = vf3_aim_fbits(vf3_aim_u32(a, addr));      a->fr[3] = fadd(a, f, a->fr[4]); vf3_aim_set_u32(a, addr, vf3_aim_ubits(a->fr[3]));
f = vf3_aim_fbits(vf3_aim_u32(a, addr));      a->fr[3] = fadd(a, f, a->fr[5]); vf3_aim_set_u32(a, addr, vf3_aim_ubits(a->fr[3]));

name: y_add_wrong_reg
subs: f = vf3_aim_fbits(vf3_aim_u32(a, addr + 4));  a->fr[2] = fadd(a, f, a->fr[5]); vf3_aim_set_u32(a, addr + 4, vf3_aim_ubits(a->fr[2]));
f = vf3_aim_fbits(vf3_aim_u32(a, addr + 4));  a->fr[2] = fadd(a, f, a->fr[6]); vf3_aim_set_u32(a, addr + 4, vf3_aim_ubits(a->fr[2]));

name: z_add_wrong_reg

f = vf3_aim_fbits(vf3_aim_u32(a, addr + 8));  a->fr[3] = fadd(a, f, a->fr[4]); vf3_aim_set_u32(a, addr + 8, vf3_aim_ubits(a->fr[3]));
